subject: Marketplace addendum: seller evidence & revenue workflow amendment
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudbridge.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudbridge.com; finance@cloudbridge.com
Date: 2027-06-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace addendum: seller evidence & revenue workflow amendment

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, our legal and finance teams need a short addendum to the MSA + Order Form that clarifies two things before we can publish the listing in the marketplace:

1) What constitutes acceptable "revenue evidence" for reseller payouts (monthly reporting, invoice traces, and audit rights).
2) How pass-through platform fees will be allocated when a customer purchases via CloudBridge (gross vs. net calculations and where liability sits).

I've attached CloudBridge's proposed redlines (v2) to the partner paper and an updated Exhibit B showing our preferred revenue schedule. Can you flag any absolute blockers from Redwood's side? Our procurement team would ideally receive final language this week so we can close the onboarding checklist.

Attachments: CloudBridge_Marketplace_Addendum_v2_redlines.docx, OrderForm_ExhibitB_revenue_schedule.pdf

Thanks —
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships
CloudBridge Inc.
elena@cloudbridge.com

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com; kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-18T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: seller evidence & revenue workflow amendment

Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the call. Initial read: nothing that looks like a deal-breaker but there are a few legal/finance items we should tighten up. Looping Ben (partner ops) and Kim (legal) to get redline guidance.

Quick notes for your team while we triage:
- We prefer "net of platform fees" for revenue reporting unless CloudBridge requires gross reporting for marketplace reporting obligations — this determines where the liability sits.
- Audit window: Redwood generally supports a two-year lookback for evidence tied to payouts; if CloudBridge needs longer we can discuss targeted exceptions.
- We'll need one operational contact for monthly reconciliation and one for escalation (to send audit evidence).

I'll follow up once Kim has a pass at the redlines.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com; maya_srinivasan@redwood.com; aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-19T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: seller evidence & revenue workflow amendment

Team — I've reviewed the redlines and drafted counterlanguage on the following high-priority items:

1) Revenue definition: Keep reporting "net of marketplace facilitation fees". Proposed sentence: ""Revenue for purposes of reseller payout = Gross invoice value less marketplace facilitation fees and refunds as evidenced by customer invoice and payment trace."" This protects Redwood from being on the hook for third-party fees.

2) Evidence and audit rights: Accept a two-year evidentiary window; add an operational process that requires CloudBridge to provide monthly reconciliation CSVs and produces a rights-based audit notice with 30 days to cure.

3) Liability carveouts: Do not accept broad indemnities tied to CloudBridge's reseller collection practices. We can accept limited liability for errors in allocation up to a fixed cap tied to payouts in the prior 12 months.

I attached a short redline doc with inline comments. I'm comfortable sharing this with CloudBridge as a clean markup tomorrow unless Ben/Aditya flag financial concerns.

Attachment: Redwood_counter_redlines_v1.docx

Kim
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com; kimberly_park@redwood.com; maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-19T11:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: seller evidence & revenue workflow amendment

Quick finance input:
- We prefer reporting net of platform fees (consistent with our current marketplace partners) — that simplifies our payout calculation and reduces reconciliation noise.
- If CloudBridge wants gross reporting, we need a reconciliations appendix and explicit proof of fee remittance (we cannot accept open-ended audits to verify third-party fee pass-through).
- Cap on liability: agree with Kim's approach; suggest language tying cap to the higher of (i) three months' average payouts or (ii) $100k for the first 12 months.

If legal is comfortable with the proposed audit cure window and the cap, finance can sign off and we'll send to CloudBridge.

Aditya Rao
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudbridge.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com; kimberly_park@redwood.com; aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-21T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: seller evidence & revenue workflow amendment — acceptance with minor edits

Hi all — appreciate the quick turnaround. CloudBridge legal and finance reviewed your countermarks and are generally aligned. Two small asks: 

1) Replace Redwood's proposed 30-day cure window with 45 days (CloudBridge says procurement lead needs slightly longer coordination).
2) For the liability cap, propose tying to the higher of (i) three months' average payouts or (ii) $150k for year one.

If Redwood can accept those two items, we can finalize the addendum and route the Order Form Exhibit B for signature. I've uploaded our doc with the requested edits and e-sig packet: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123-CloudBridge.

Attachments: CloudBridge_Marketplace_Addendum_v3_redlines.docx

I'll stand by for a final word — procurement wants the doc in the next 48 hours.

Best,
Elena
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge Inc.
